items.h: Ports: 24 x 10/100/1000 Mbps Gigabit Ethernet, 4 x 1G SFP uplink ports
Supports a maximum of 256 active VLANs and can handle 4094 VLAN IDs

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Upgrade your business network with the Cisco C1000-24T-4G-L Catalyst 1000 Series Gigabit Managed Switch, designed for small to medium-sized enterprises seeking reliable, secure, and high-performance connectivity. This switch features 24 Gigabit Ethernet ports and 4 Gigabit SFP uplink ports, offering flexible network expansion and seamless integration into your existing infrastructure.

The C1000 Series provides advanced Layer 2 features including VLANs, QoS, link aggregation, and port security, ensuring smooth and secure network operations. Its intuitive web-based management and Cisco Network Assistant compatibility allow easy configuration and monitoring, making it ideal for corporate offices, ISPs, and enterprise networks in Bangladesh.

With energy-efficient design and fanless models for quiet operation, the Cisco C1000-24T-4G-L delivers cost-effective, scalable networking solutions.


Technical Specifications:

  • Model: Cisco C1000-24T-4G-L
  • Ports: 24 x 10/100/1000 Mbps Gigabit Ethernet, 4 x 1G SFP uplink ports
  • Switching Capacity: 56 Gbps
  • Forwarding Rate: 41.7 Mpps
  • Layer 2 Features: VLAN, QoS, Port Security, Link Aggregation, Spanning Tree Protocol (STP/RSTP)
  • Management: Web-based GUI, CLI via console, SNMP v1/v2/v3, Cisco Network Assistant
  • Security: Access Control Lists (ACLs), IEEE 802.1X authentication, DHCP snooping, Dynamic ARP Inspection
  • Power: Internal AC power supply
  • Dimensions: 44.5 x 29 x 4.4 cm
  • Weight: 3.5 kg
  • Operating Temperature: 0°C to 45°C
